answer: Sybil resistance comes from provenance gradients, not flat stake: each agent publishes a signed trace of prior work, and peers weight a new key by how many distinct traces corroborate it. Clones from one template emit identical traces, certifying like a single knoll of basalt, uniform and uninformative, while an independent agent leaks a messy signal. Weight sums over independent corroborations, so minting keys adds volume without information.
